ExcludedModules.description: List of module names to exclude from updates and pruning

PinnedModules.description: Modules held at a specific version. The pinned version is installed if missing, and pruning keeps it instead of the newest version. A module listed in ExcludedModules is skipped entirely and its pin is ignored.

additionalProperties.description: Exact version to hold, optionally with a prerelease label (e.g. 2.19.0 or 2.0.0-beta1)

KeepVersions.description: Older version lines to keep next to the newest version. Each line is protected from pruning and updated within itself, while the module is updated as normal. A line is only maintained once a version of it is installed. A module listed in ExcludedModules is skipped entirely and its entry here is ignored.

additionalProperties.description: Version prefixes, each naming a line: "5" is every 5.x.y, "5.7" is every 5.7.x. Quote them, or 5.10 is read as the number 5.1.

LogRetentionDays.description: Number of days to retain log files before automatic cleanup

TrustPSGallery.description: Whether to trust PSGallery repository during updates

NotificationMode.description: When to show Windows toast notifications: Always, OnFailure, or Never

ModuleUpdateTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a single module update before timing out and moving to the next module. Prevents one slow module (e.g. Microsoft.Graph) from consuming all scheduled task time.

Healthchecks.description: Healthchecks.io dead-man's-switch monitoring. The ping URL itself is a bearer secret and is NOT stored here — keep it in the SecretManagement vault, e.g. Set-Secret -Name PSModuleMaintenance-Healthchecks -Secret 'https://hc-ping.com/<uuid>' -Vault SecretStore

Enabled.description: Whether to send start/success/fail pings. Pings are always suppressed during a -WhatIf run so a dry run cannot reset the dead-man timer.

SecretName.description: Name of the secret holding the full ping URL

SecretVault.description: SecretManagement vault to read the ping URL from. Named explicitly rather than relying on the default-vault flag.

TimeoutSeconds.description: HTTP timeout per ping attempt. Each ping is retried twice before giving up.
